review.notes: Token-level diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 35 physical pages; physical pages 1, 8, 22, 25 and 26 were additionally inspected against rendered pages. The only dropped text is the physical p.1 footnote block (correspondence e-mail and the copyright line); the OCR keeps the 'MiniMax(1)' marker. All other missing tokens belong to diagram text inside the embedded figure images (Fig. 4 Forge RL system with the SWE-Scaling/Appdev pipeline banners on p.8, the Fig. 5 windowed-FIFO node labels on p.22, and the Fig. 6/7/8 panel banners on p.25-26), which remain visible in the embedded figures. No unbalanced code fences, no spaced-digit equation corruption, and the single 'MiniMax\_AI' backslash-underscore escape renders to the underscore that the source URL actually prints.
